title: ChatGPT
tagline: The world's most popular AI chatbot for writing, coding, and research.
description: ChatGPT is a large language model developed by OpenAI. It excels at natural conversation, long-form writing, code generation, and summarisation. The free tier uses GPT-3.5, while ChatGPT Plus ($20/month) unlocks GPT-4o with faster responses and image understanding.
metaDescription: ChatGPT review: pricing, pros, cons, and who it's best for. See how it compares to other AI tools.
pros: Strong coding assistant via Code Interpreter
Available on web, iOS, and Android
cons: Free tier is slower and less capable
No real-time web access on free plan
